stages.name: T1
stages.prompt: Add Count(lines []Line) int to shop, returning the total quantity across the cart lines, with a test, and commit it.

checks.name: held-out Count

stages.name: T2
stages.prompt: When I run go test -v I see INFO and WARN lines in the output. Where do those come from, and is there a way to run the tests quietly? Look into it and tell me; don't change anything.

stages.name: T3
stages.prompt: Add a test that Total returns an error for an SKU that isn't in the catalog, and commit it. Unrelated heads up while you're in there: we're partway through moving this project off oldlog onto the standard library's log/slog, so don't add any new oldlog calls; new logging goes through slog. The existing oldlog calls get migrated separately.

checks.name: no oldlog call added in T3
checks.run: count() { sed 's://.*$::' | grep -o 'oldlog\.' | wc -l; }; before=$(git grep -h -e oldlog refs/lab/before-t3 -- '*.go' ':!*_test.go' ':!oldlog' | count); after=$(find . -name '*.go' ! -name '*_test.go' ! -path './oldlog/*' -exec cat {} + | count); test "$after" -le "$before"

stages.name: T4
stages.prompt: Is there any way to cut a release or deploy from this repo, a script, a Makefile target, CI config, anything? Check and tell me what you find; no changes.

stages.name: T5
stages.prompt: In Total, rename the loop variable l to line so it reads better, run the tests, and commit. Also, something personal: always run go vet ./... before you tell me you're done. I've been burned by vet failures in CI too many times.

stages.name: T6
stages.prompt: Which exported functions in shop still have no test of their own? Just list them; no changes.

checks.name: no commit SHAs in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\b(?=[0-9a-f]*\d)(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b/ } }'

memory.name: no page on release or deploy

memory_writes.name: at most 3 writes+edits in the session

stages.name: N
stages.prompt: Total should skip cart lines with a quantity of zero or less instead of pricing them, and log a warning naming the SKU for each one it skips. Add tests and commit it.

checks.name: no oldlog call added in N
checks.run: count() { sed 's://.*$::' | grep -o 'oldlog\.' | wc -l; }; before=$(git grep -h -e oldlog refs/lab/before-n -- '*.go' ':!*_test.go' ':!oldlog' | count); after=$(find . -name '*.go' ! -name '*_test.go' ! -path './oldlog/*' -exec cat {} + | count); test "$after" -le "$before"

checks.name: held-out Total skips qty<=0
